description: For the moment before a buy ("should I buy this?", "should I ape this?"): Toll answers with facts, not advice. One call before buying a coin on Robinhood Chain: Toll reads the coin (its full coin check, counted in the same free coins) and answers Decision: BLOCK / WARN / ALLOW / WAIT with up to 3 reasons, most severe first, on Toll's calibrated pre-sign rules (BLOCK = a finding whose coins rugged at 40% or more within 24 h in Toll's calibration or among the coin's own launcher's coins of the last 7 days, the coin's pool liquidity already pulled once, or sells that fail). WAIT means part of the coin is still being read: call again after the seconds given. Facts, not advice; ALLOW means nothing against was found in what was read, never a promise. Robinhood Chain only.

address.description: The token contract address you are about to buy on Robinhood Chain: 0x followed by 40 hex characters

budget_ms.description: Optional: your time budget in ms (a trading bot's timeout, 300-25000). Not read in time = WAIT with the seconds to ask again; the read goes on, so the next call is fast.
